name: Sentora Huma PST Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDPST is Sentora's PYUSD vault lending against Huma PST on Morpho; shares redeem into available PYUSD and bear lending losses.
collateral: PYUSD held idle in an immutable Morpho Vault V2 and supplied by a MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 to a Huma PST-collateralized lending market. Allocations can change under curator controls.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares convert to PYUSD at the live assets-per-share rate. Interest, fees and recognized losses change share value. liquidityAdapter() is zero at pinned block 26107706; ordinary cash redemptions use idle assets unless assets are first deallocated. Shared market liquidity does not promise full-size cash redemption.
